How to Apply
Your Application Checklist for Graduate Programs
1. Transcripts
Please provide official transcripts from all attended colleges and universities.
International Students: If you have already graduated from your previous institution at the time of your application, please email graduation certificate(s) attached as PDF or Microsoft Word documents to enroll@drexel.edu
2. Standardized Tests
No GRE needed!
International Students: TOEFL scores are required for all international applicants or applicants who earned a degree outside the US. Though the exam is required, the School performs a holistic application review.
3. Essay
Please prepare approximately 500 words explaining our reasons for pursuing a degree from Drexel; your short-term and long-term career plans; and how your background, experience, interest, and/or values, when combined with a Drexel degree, will enable you to pursue these goals successfully.
Please submit your essay with your application or through the Discover Drexel Portal after you submit your application.
4. Resume
Please upload your resume as part of your admission application or through the Discover Drexel Portal after you submit your application.
5. Letters of Recommendation
Two letters of recommendation are required. To electronically request recommendations, you must list your recommenders and their contact information with your application or through the Discover Drexel Portal after you submit your application.
